metrics.label: Brent crude
metrics.blurb: The global benchmark price for crude oil. Most oil cargoes price off it.

metrics.label: WTI crude
metrics.blurb: The US crude benchmark. Its gap to Brent drives US export volumes.

metrics.label: Dutch TTF gas
metrics.blurb: Europe's benchmark gas price, set in the Netherlands.
metrics.no_free_source: Dutch TTF is licensed by ICE and no free provider publishes it. Henry Hub is the closest free gas benchmark; the TTF–JKM spread is what actually steers LNG cargoes.

metrics.label: Henry Hub gas
metrics.blurb: The US benchmark gas price, set in Louisiana.

metrics.label: Coal API2 (ARA)
metrics.blurb: Price of coal delivered into northwest Europe. A dry bulk demand signal.
metrics.no_free_source: API2 coal is an Argus/McCloskey assessment and is not published free.

metrics.label: Heating oil / gasoil
metrics.blurb: A refined product price that tracks what bunker fuel costs.
metrics.no_free_source: Refined product futures are exchange-licensed; no free daily source.

metrics.label: RBOB gasoline
metrics.blurb: US gasoline price. Strong margins here pull product tankers west.
metrics.no_free_source: Refined product futures are exchange-licensed; no free daily source.

metrics.label: Dry bulk ETF (BDRY)
metrics.blurb: An ETF holding dry bulk freight futures. A rough daily read on bulker sentiment.
metrics.no_free_source: ETF quotes need an equity data provider; none is free from a server.

metrics.label: Tanker ETF (BWET)
metrics.blurb: An ETF holding tanker freight futures. A rough daily read on tanker sentiment.
metrics.no_free_source: ETF quotes need an equity data provider; none is free from a server.

metrics.label: Baltic Dry Index
metrics.blurb: The Baltic Exchange's headline dry bulk freight index. Published late afternoon London time, so a morning brief shows the previous session.
metrics.source: Baltic Exchange via Hellenic Shipping News

metrics.label: VLSFO Singapore
metrics.blurb: Price of the main low-sulphur marine fuel at the world's biggest bunker port.

metrics.label: VLSFO Rotterdam
metrics.blurb: The same fuel in Europe's biggest bunker port.

metrics.label: VLSFO Fujairah
metrics.blurb: The Middle East bunker hub, where most VLCC voyages refuel.

metrics.label: Diesel crack vs Brent
metrics.blurb: Roughly what a refinery makes turning a barrel of crude into diesel. Computed as the gasoil price converted to barrels minus Brent. Fat margins make refineries run hard, which creates product tanker cargo.

metrics.label: Brent–WTI spread
metrics.blurb: How much more Brent costs than WTI. A wide gap makes exporting US crude profitable, which means more long-haul cargoes and stronger tanker demand.
